text: Fairphone is a private social enterprise founded in January 2013 by Bas van Abel, Tessa Wernink and Miquel Ballester, and a registered B Corporation since April 2015. In 2023 a consortium of impact investors led by new shareholders Invest-NL and the ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund, alongside existing shareholder Quadia with its Regenero Impact Fund, invested 49 million euros in Fairphone. No state body controls the company.
